{{Quote|They offered me a small fortune in chrysopaz and aurodium in exchange for my services, but after one sip of their hot Jawa juice, made using an ancient Ryn technique with freshly roasted ardees seeds, I asked for the recipe and nothing else in return.|The menu at Dex's describes how he acquired the adrees seed recipe for his Jawa juice|<ref name="Dining at Dex's">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>}}
'''Ardees seeds''' were a type of [[Seed/Legends|seed]]. Roasted ardees seeds were used by the [[Ryn/Legends|Ryn]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in an ancient recipe for [[Ardees/Legends|Jawa juice]]. The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] cook [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] asked for this recipe as the only repayment for delivering goods to several Ryn settlers on an unnamed [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] as it was the best Jawa juice he'd ever tasted and subsequently served it in his [[Dex's Diner/Legends|diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
